'''Glarial's Tomb''' is a dungeon underneath the [[Glarial's tombstone|tombstone]] near the [[Baxtorian Falls]] and the Kingdom of [[Kandarin]]. To enter, the player needs [[Glarial's pebble]], which is obtained during the [[Waterfall Quest]], and must not have any [[weapons]], [[armour]] or [[runes]] either equipped or in their inventory. Level 84 [[moss guardian]]s roam here.

The location is close to the [[Fishing Guild]]; use Glarial's pebble on her tombstone and you may enter. Players can get [[Glarial's amulet]] in the west chest. This location can be re-entered after the Waterfall Quest has been completed in order to obtain Glarial's amulet once again.

Glarial's tomb is also involved with the [[Roving Elves]] quest. The player has to kill a [[Moss Guardian|moss guardian]] completely unarmed and unarmoured ([[food]] and [[potions]] are allowed) to obtain a [[consecration seed]].

The tomb has a roaming [[mysterious ghost]] outside of it named [[Valdez]], who can only be seen when wearing the [[Ring of visibility]]. This ghost starts the [[Curse of the Empty Lord]] [[miniquest]].

==Restricted items==
Items not allowed here include:
*[[Weapons]] of any kind, including axes, pickaxes, staves, and the [[Ham joint]]
*[[Armour]] or supplies to create them. This includes metal gloves from the [[Culinaromancer chest]], as well as [[Fancy boots]] (or its analogues Fighting/Fancier boots)
**[[Knife]]
**[[Fletching knife]]
**[[Needle]]
**[[Thread]]
**[[Ball of wool]]
**Any type of [[Tanner#Leathers|leather]]
**[[Nails]]
**[[Item_set#Temple_Knight_sets|Temple Knight sets]]
*[[Runes]] or [[item pack|rune packs]]
*[[Arrows]] or any other type of [[Ranged]] [[ammo]], or supplies to create them
**[[Feathers]] or [[feather pack]]s
**[[Headless arrow]]s
**[[Arrow shaft]]s
**[[Arrowtips]]
**[[Logs]] (e.g. [[magic logs]])
**[[Bow string]]
**Unstrung [[bow]]s
*[[Looting bag]], even if it has no forbidden items
*[[Clue scroll]]s
*[[Magic secateurs]]
*[[Mythical cape]]
*[[Cape of Accomplishment|Skillcapes]]
*[[Ardougne cloak]]
*Weight-reducing [[Custom Fur Clothing|camo clothing]] made from [[Hunter]] furs
*[[Dwarf multicannon]]

The restrictions are much stricter than the restrictions to enter [[Entrana]].

==Allowed items==
Allowed items include:
*[[Potions]]
*[[Jewellery]] (including [[Ring of recoil]] and stat boosting jewellery, e.g. [[Amulet of power]])
*[[Clothing]] (e.g. [[Monk's robes]], [[Graceful outfit|Graceful]], [[Boots of lightness]], [[Ice gloves]], [[H.A.M. robes]])
**However, the [[Ardougne cloak]] and weight-reducing [[Custom Fur Clothing|camo clothing]] made from [[Hunter]] furs are both NOT allowed
*[[Coins]]
*[[Goblin paint cannon]]
*[[Rune pouch]] if it does not contain runes
*[[Chronicle]]
*[[Experience lamps]]
*[[Food]]
*[[God blessing|Blessings]]
*[[Dynamite(p)]]
*[[Reward casket]]s (any tier)
*[[Mystery box]]
*[[Forgotten lockbox]]
*[[Costume needle]]
*[[Mixed hide base]]
*[[Jaguar fur]], [[Fox fur]] and [[Sunlight antelope fur]]
*[[Xerician fabric]]
*[[Imcando hammer (off-hand)]]
*[[Tome of Water]], [[Tome of Earth]], [[Tome of Fire]]
*[[Huntsman's kit]], allowing the smuggling of [[Hunter's spear|Hunter's spears]] and weight-reducing camo clothing made from Hunter furs

Additionally, runes can be smuggled in by uncharging certain items:
*[[Ash sanctifier]] (death runes)
*[[Circlet of water]] (water runes)
*[[Cowbell amulet]] (air runes)
*[[Ring of shadows]] (law, death, blood and soul runes)
*[[Soul bearer]] (blood and soul runes)
This could enable players to use combat spells from a [[safespot]] to kill the moss guardian during Roving Elves.
